commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
npm run build
for f in dist/cli.js dist/index.js dist/index.d.ts dist/cli.js.map dist/index.js.map dist/index.d.ts.map; do
  if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
    echo "::error::missing $f after npm run build"
    exit 1
  fi
done
npm pack --dry-run --json > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pack.json"
cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pack.json"
missing=0
for req in LICENSE CHANGELOG.md; do
  if ! jq -e --arg p "$req" '
    (if type == "array" then .[0] else . end).files
    | map(.path | gsub("\\\\"; "/"))
    | index($p)
  ' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pack.json" >/dev/null; then
    echo "::error::npm pack omits ${req} (Shipcheck D5)"
    missing=1
  fi
done
if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit 1
fi
